_readme: Single source of truth for the traded universe and monitored
correlation pairs. Every entry point (producer, consumers,
scheduler, API, slim profile, live-site publisher, backtest
harness) loads this file once at startup; adding or removing a
symbol or pair requires editing only this file.
Labels are human-readable names shown in the API and dashboards.
Correlation pairs must reference symbols defined in the symbol
list — the loader fails fast with a clear error otherwise.
